title: Submission
summary: Values accepted by Preact programmatic submissions.

sections.title: Supported values
sections.body: Submission is FormData, HTMLFormElement, or Record<string, unknown>. FormData is passed through unchanged. A form element is converted to FormData. Ordinary object fields are converted with String(value), so use FormData for files or repeated field names.

sections.title: Structured JSON
sections.body: With encType: "application/json", the object is serialized into a _payload form field. The route handler reads it with readSubmission(request). This encoding does not send a raw application/json body. Avoid including a form element or FormData when the intended payload is structured JSON; pass the object itself.

sections.title: Destinations
sections.body: The value contains the submission body, not its destination. Select the route with options.action. Programmatic submission of a form element reads its controls; supply the intended action and method explicitly. For an independent request and result state, use useFetcher rather than useSubmit.
